app.title: Python Quest
d1.name: The Crypt of Variables
d1.intro: A variable is a box storing a value. In Python there is no type to declare (unlike Java/C++): x = 5.
d1r1.q: Which line creates a variable in Python?
d1r2.q: Create the variable name with the value "Merlin" (in quotes).
d1boss.q: BOSS: add 5 to hp so print(hp) shows 15.
d2.name: The Maze of Choices
d2.intro: if / elif / else: code picks its path. Indentation (4 spaces) replaces braces.
d2r2.q: Inside the if, print the word cast.
d2boss.q: BOSS: print odd if x is odd (use x % 2).
d3.name: The Tower of Loops
d3r2.q: Print i in the loop to get 0 1 2 (one per line).
d3boss.q: BOSS: print the numbers 1 to 5, one per line.
